_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With 0 of 73 windows producing a ±2+ point score move, the statistically dominant outcome is the coil persists at Denial; a directional call requires seeing the breaker (funding <0.008%, BTC momentum >50, fear_greed >35) which has not yet materialized.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst leans UP toward Hope on macro tailwinds while narrative describes a coiling tension without committing to direction; consensus defaults to HOLD as the skilled call in a 0% base-rate coil.
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC momentum_30d holds above 50 AND fear_greed climbs above 35 AND funding remains below 0.008% — this confirms the spring is releasing upward.
next_move.invalidated_if: fear_greed drops below 25 OR funding spikes above 0.015% with price stalling OR VIX breaks above 20 with DXY strengthening — any of these re-traps in Denial or pushes to Anxiety.
